h1: JLCCNC September & October 2026 Holiday Schedule Notice

headings.text: JLCCNC September & October 2026 Holiday Schedule Notice

meta_description: JLCCNC factories will be closed on Sep 25, 27, and Oct 1–4, 2026. Check our full production and shipping schedule to plan your orders in advance.
monitored_text: Home Newsroom JLCCNC September & October 2026 Holiday Schedule Notice JLCCNC September & October 2026 Holiday Schedule Notice Press Release Sep 15, 2026 Table of Contents Production & Delivery Notes JLCCNC Holiday Schedule Logistics Companies Schedule Plan Ahead for Smooth Delivery Dear Customers, JLCCNC factories will be closed for holidays on September 25, September 27, and October 1–4, 2026 . During these dates, factory production and related operations will be temporarily suspended. During these non-working dates, factory production and shipping carrier pickups will be temporarily suspended. Normal production and dispatch will fully resume on October 5, 2026 . To avoid unexpected project delays, we strongly recommend placing time-sensitive orders at least 3–5 business days prior to the holiday closures. Please refer to the detailed schedules below for the specific holiday and work arrangements. Production & Delivery Notes Ordering: Our online platform remains available for quotes and order placement. You can continue to submit orders as usual. Production: Production schedules will be adjusted during the holidays, and affected orders may experience extended lead times depending on the service and production line. Shipping: Shipping schedules may be affected by holiday arrangements and logistics service availability. Delivery may take longer than usual for some orders. Lead Time: Production lead times may be affected by holiday arrangements. Please expect possible delays or adjustments to delivery dates during the holiday period. JLCCNC Holiday Schedule September： October： Logistics Companies Schedule September： October： Plan Ahead for Smooth Delivery Due to the cumulative order volume during factory closures, lead times immediately following the holiday period may be slightly longer than standard turnaround times. Please evaluate your prototyping and production timelines and submit your orders 3–5 business days in advance to secure earlier manufacturing queue slots and shipping arrangements. Thank you for your understanding, continued trust, and cooperation.
